title: Bounded subsets of a k-frame span have finite H^k-measure
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P with span G := span{g_1, …, g_k}; H^k := μHE[k]. Then every bounded set E ⊆ G (Bornology.IsBounded E) has finite H^k-measure: μHE[k] E ≠ ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ g → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), E ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) : Set (Euclid P)) → Bornology.IsBounded E → μHE[k] E ≠ ∞
